July 2026
 
 
 
 
 
Event Analytics & Funnel Updates
 
 
 
 
 
Give the increasing usage by the product and growth teams, we are delighted to introduce a whole set of new additions to our Event Analytics and Funnel modules.
While using our Event Analytics module, you can now add multiple events and splits across multiple attributes – all visualisations presented in the same viewport as shown below. 
Did you notice that you could use multi-splits with Formula based metrics too
?
While analysing your Funnels, you can now switch seamlessly between 
Uniques
 or 
Occurrences
 depending on the question you are trying to find an answer for. Also, you can now compare your funnels across time period – current vs last month etc.
The key addition is 
Context Aware Funnels
!
Did you know that when you look at event based funnel in any tool, there’s no context carried forward at each step? Well, say you have a funnel Product Viewed -> Added To Card -> Product Purchased. Any user who does all these three events in that sequence is a “converted” user. No matter which product they dealt with at each step of the funnel. Our context aware funnels solves this for you (example shown b

Home

Security
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Security built for 
 Enterprise-Grade Scale
 
 
 
 
 
As a WebEngage customer, your information is protected with advanced encryption, compliant infrastructure, and regular security assessments. Our Customer Data Platform (CDP) is built with security at its core, enabling you to manage customer data securely.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Learn more about WebEngage's security compliances, audit reports and extensive controls
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Trust Centre
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
850+ global brands trust WebEngage for customer engagement and retention
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Edit Template
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We Ensure 100% Customer Data 
 Protection at WebEngage
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data governance
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
With the WebEngage CDP, we provide comprehensive tools and features to help our customers comply with essential data privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and more. Our offerings include solutions for managing profile consent and handling requests for data access and deletion.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
External Audit
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
WebEngage undergoes annual third-party audits to ensure our internal controls are designed and operated effectively, following industry standards such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Our third-party audit reports can be downloaded directly from our self-service Trust Center.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Your Customers’ Data Security Is Our #1 Priority
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Data Encryption 
 
 
 
 TLS Protocols with SHA256 algorithms to handle data communications. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 SSO Login 
 
 
 
 IDP integration. SSO login to govern your password and user management policies. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Data Access 
 
 
 
 Role based access control and maker-checker principles available. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Data Hashing 
 
 
 
 User contact information can be hashed. PII data can be masked. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Audit Log 
 
 
 
 All actions taken by an admin,
